title: Recognise no object
summary: Objective-C: Recognise no object. Give name @"Asha".
introduction: nil means no object. Checking it can select a fallback message.

blocks.text: On a Mac with Xcode command-line tools, save lesson.m. Run clang -fobjc-arc -framework Foundation lesson.m -o lesson, then ./lesson.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not add nil to an NSArray; it expects an object.
